image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) on a sandy surface. The beetle exhibits vibrant metallic green and blue coloration with distinct pale markings on its elytra. It has large compound eyes, prominent mandibles, and long, slender legs. The background is a soft-focus beige sand texture.
